text_en: A paper on LLM agents for traffic accident handling was selected for presentation at ACM MobiCom 2025.
text_zh: 交通事故处理 LLM 智能体相关论文入选 ACM MobiCom 2025 展示。

text_en: Research on user authentication with out-ear microphones in commercial earphones was accepted by IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing.
text_zh: 利用商用耳机外置麦克风开展身份认证的研究获 IEEE Transactions on Mobile Computing 接收。

text_en: Amulet, which combines sensitive information access and identity authentication on mobile devices, was accepted by ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2025.
text_zh: Amulet 移动设备敏感信息访问与身份认证研究获 ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2025 接收。

text_en: Research on black-box keystroke inference attacks against mobile devices was accepted by ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2025.
text_zh: 面向移动设备的黑盒击键推断攻击研究获 ACM IMWUT / UbiComp 2025 接收。

text_en: GPSBuster research on hidden GPS tracker detection was accepted at ACM CCS 2024.
text_zh: GPSBuster 隐蔽 GPS 追踪器检测研究获 ACM CCS 2024 接收。
